description: Group photograph of five former U.S. presidents seated in a row with Lady Gaga standing behind them in a white suit. From left: Jimmy Carter, Barack Obama, George H.W. Bush (in a wheelchair), George W. Bush, and Bill Clinton, posed against a dark curtain backdrop. The photo is from the One America Appeal hurricane-relief benefit concert in College Station, Texas, October 21 2017, where Lady Gaga performed.

Meme built on a photograph of a severely tilted, partially collapsed apartment building propped up by steel support beams, consistent with an earthquake-damaged building in Taiwan. The building is captioned DEMOCRAT PARTY and each supporting beam is labeled with a media outlet name (CNN, MSNBC, CBS, NBC), asserting that mainstream media props up the Democratic Party. Watermarked @unfiltered.politics.

description: Sepia-toned Civil War-era photograph of an African American Union Army sergeant in uniform, chevrons on his sleeve, standing and holding a large American flag; a painted backdrop with a U.S. banner is visible behind him. The image matches the widely circulated 1860s portrait identified as Sgt. William Harvey Carney of the 54th Massachusetts Volunteer Infantry, who saved the regimental colors at Fort Wagner and became the first Black Medal of Honor recipient. No caption or text appears in the image itself.
flags: Identification as William Harvey Carney rests on the widely published attribution of this portrait, not on text in the image

description: Side-by-side iceberg meme comparing the Trump silent majority in 2016 and 2020. Both panels show an iceberg beneath a Trump campaign logo with an American flag in the sky; the left panel (TRUMP 2016) shows a modest submerged mass, while the right panel (TRUMP 2020) shows a vastly larger underwater portion, claiming Trump's hidden support had grown far larger for 2020. Both panels are captioned SILENT MAJORITY; a small dark watermark sits in the lower right corner.
